description: The full text of a search result, by its id (or any scriptura.si link): a verse in every edition, a paragraph in the original and the translation, a section, a work's contents, a Bible chapter, a writer or a shelf. Returns the text, the permanent link to cite, and metadata.

id.description: An id from search, e.g. "bible/john/1#v-14" or "works/plato-republic/7#p-3", or a scriptura.si link.
